name: sonora-design
description: Design System panel for this repo, hosted in a VS Code webview — feature parity with claude.ai/design's own panel (see docs/EXTENSION-PLAN.md).

sonora.python.description: Interpreter used to run docs/serve.py and docs/gen_gallery.py.

sonora.serverPort.description: Port the gallery server (docs/serve.py) answers on. docs/serve.py itself always binds 8888 — see extension/lib/server.js's header comment before changing this.

enumDescriptions: File a queue item through ~/.claude/skills/queue's own CLI (extension/lib/queue.js) — the default on this machine, where a headless `claude -p` becomes a queue item anyway.
Fall back to docs/serve.py's own /_api/feedback — the same headless `claude -p` path the framed page's Feedback button would take if it were running unframed in a browser.
Record the feedback in .feedback/queue.jsonl (same shape docs/serve.py itself writes) without filing or running anything.
sonora.regenerate.description: How the Feedback button's request is carried out. See docs/EXTENSION-PLAN.md §2 "Settings".
